For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

For a leading American multinational company in the consumer products industry, recognized worldwide for its innovation and commitment to quality, we are currently looking for a Lab Associate to strengthen the team. This is a unique opportunity to work in a high-tech environment where safety, quality, and continuous improvement are at the forefront. Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and eager to work in a modern laboratory setting? Then this position may be the perfect fit for you. In this role: 

 
• you will be responsible for a variety of laboratory activities carried out in accordance with established procedures 
 
•  
 You will organize, set up, and perform stability testing using a range of laboratory instruments, including pH meters, viscometers, colorimeters, ovens, incubators, and climate chambers. 

 
•  
 You will test the enzymatic activity of finished products using a spectrophotometer, following standard operating procedures. 

 
•  
 You will collect various samples, including water samples, swabs, ambient plates, and raw materials, ensuring proper sampling techniques are applied. 

 
• You will be responsible for sampling incoming materials and preparing them for laboratory analysis. 
 
• You will plan and perform FTIR testing when required, maintaining a high level of accuracy throughout the process. 
 
• You will ensure accurate administration and data management by entering and maintaining laboratory data in the relevant systems. 
 
•  
 You will act as a communication link between departments and suppliers, proactively helping to resolve issues when they arise.

 
• You hold at least an A2 diploma in Science/Chemistry or have relevant laboratory experience. 
 
• You have a good command of English, both written and spoken (mandatory). 
 
• You are familiar with Microsoft Office applications and can use them confidently and efficiently.

jobs.occupation: Senior Mechanical & Piping Project Engineer, Technical Lead
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

This role focuses on senior technical project engineering rather than administrative coordination or conventional project management. As the technical lead in multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, you help deliver safe, feasible and maintainable solutions within a controlled project environment.

You operate in an operational brownfield setting where safety, reliability, technical quality and limited disruption to production are essential. The position combines specialist Mechanical & Piping expertise with a broad view of engineering, execution and handover activities.

Responsibilities

• Establish and maintain the technical basis, design philosophy, project scope and battery limits.
• Lead and align engineering work across disciplines, with Mechanical & Piping as the core area and close cooperation with process, E&I, automation, civil, safety and infrastructure teams.
• Organise design reviews and assess solutions for safety, compliance, functionality, reliability, maintainability, constructability and lifecycle value.
• Convert process and project requirements into Mechanical & Piping concepts, and oversee the quality of layouts, P&IDs, equipment specifications, piping classes, routing and isometrics.
• Evaluate technical alternatives with regard to feasibility, safety, reliability and cost-effectiveness.
• Give technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors, and critically review their content, quality, planning and deliverable completeness.
• Support technical decision-making, record assumptions and deviations, and ensure that decisions and follow-up actions remain traceable.
• Identify technical and project risks, assessing how changes may affect scope, schedule, cost, execution and business continuity.
• Contribute to technical specifications, tender packages, bid evaluations, supplier selection and contractual technical clarifications.
• Follow up Mechanical & Piping activities where relevant, including fabrication, inspections, FAT, delivery, installation, SAT and punch-list management through mechanical completion.
• Provide engineering support during construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover.
• Support the Project Manager with clear technical recommendations and transparent stakeholder reporting.
• Coach engineers and contribute to project engineering standards, methodologies, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.
Location

Olen, with 100% onsite presence.

Selection procedure

The selection process consists of two interview rounds: an initial interview via Teams, followed by an on-site interview that includes a business case.

• You have a master's degree in a technical discipline, or an equivalent level gained through relevant experience. A background in electromechanics or chemical technology is particularly relevant.
• You bring extensive experience in technical design and engineering within an industrial or process environment.
• You have demonstrable specialist knowledge of Mechanical & Piping engineering in the process industry or another heavy industrial environment.
• You have proven experience with multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, from concept and basic engineering through execution and completion.
• You can provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors and critically assess their deliverables.
• You are familiar with applicable Mechanical & Piping standards and good engineering practices, including PED, ATEX and EN 13480.
• You hold a VCA-VOL certificate or are willing to obtain one before the start.
• Knowledge of AutoCAD Plant 3D is an asset.
• You can work with project controls covering scope, schedule, costs, risks, changes and stakeholder management.
• You combine technical depth with a broad overview, decisiveness and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
• You communicate complex technical topics clearly and work effectively with different stakeholders.
• You work in a structured, autonomous and results-oriented manner, with a strong sense of ownership.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and professionally in English. Other languages are an advantage.

Flint Group Digital Xeikon

Lead industrial inkjet development from business case to market introduction, bringing multidisciplinary teams together to turn customer needs into production-ready printing solutions.
 

About Flint Group Digital Xeikon and the role
 

Flint Group Digital Xeikon, part of Flint Group, develops digital printing solutions for labels and packaging. As R&D Project Manager, you will lead projects across our inkjet portfolio, including Panther UV inkjet label presses and IDERA aqueous inkjet solutions for corrugated applications.
 

Reporting to the Director Inkjet & Program Management, you will guide development, validation, industrialisation and launch, leading cross-functional teams through collaboration and influence.
 

What you will do
 

--> see attachement
 

What you bring
 

• 
 A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, applied science or technology, or equivalent relevant experience.
 

• 
 At least five years of project management experience in complex industrial product development, including work with external suppliers or development partners.
 

• 
 Strong planning, budget and risk management skills, with experience of validation, industrialisation and structured project reviews.
 

• 
 The technical judgement to work across disciplines, communicate clearly and align stakeholders without formal authority.
 

• 
 Professional proficiency in English and willingness to travel internationally when projects require it. Dutch or other languages are an advantage.
 

Industrial inkjet, digital printing, capital equipment or hardware/software development experience is an advantage. Project management certification is welcome but not essential.
 

Why join us
 

Own technically challenging projects with a direct impact on Flint Group Digital Xeikon’s global inkjet portfolio. Collaborate with engineering specialists and international partners, and help improve how we develop and deliver products. Hybrid working is available in line with company policy. We offer a salary package with fringe benefits in line with the market.
 

Interested
